dimensions.evidenceA: The God of Israel is said to be seen, with sapphire-like pavement under his feet.
dimensions.evidenceB: The divine face is withheld; goodness passes and the back may be seen.
dimensions.label: What is seen

dimensions.evidenceA: The LORD does not lay a hand on the nobles, who eat and drink.
dimensions.evidenceB: Moses is covered in a cleft because seeing the face is linked to death.
dimensions.label: Life and protection

evidence.observation: Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy elders go up; they see the God of Israel, are not struck, and eat and drink.
When Moses asks to see glory, the LORD says that a human may not see the divine face and live, covers Moses, and allows sight of the back but not the face.

record.tension: Exodus 24 says Israel’s representatives see God and live, while Exodus 33 says a human may not see the divine face and live.
record.title: Can a human see God and live?
